title: Community and connection: A study on social connection among LGBTQ+ New Yorkers (MPX NYC report)
description:
Source and rendered pages of the MPX NYC report, published at mpxresponse.org: findings of RESPND-MI, a community-led network survey during the 2022 mpox outbreak among queer and trans New Yorkers, with appendices on context, survey description, causal inference under network interference (Appendix C, SSNAC III: Causality), organizing, marketing, measurement and results.

Each archived version is a snapshot of the whole site. To cite a statement in a particular version of an appendix, cite this record's version DOI together with the appendix and its version date.
